methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU's Google-backed AI incubator represents distributed capability-building outside the NoVA corridor, with potential for deep peer-to-peer learning networks if the incubator model emphasizes skill transfer rather than just platform adoption.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals bottom-up capability development in historically underserved regions, testing whether grassroots approaches can overcome the typical metro-concentration pattern.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's AI Ready RVA partnership consolidates Richmond as a secondary AI hub, but the university-anchored model risks replicating concentration dynamics rather than distributing capability to surrounding rural counties.

signals.title: $100B data center project proposed at Berry Hill megasite advances
signals.signal_reading: Berry Hill's $100B data center megasite brings infrastructure investment to Southside but creates jobs requiring specialized skills the region may lack, potentially widening the gap between capital deployment and local capability development.

signals.title: Virginia's Dominion and NextEra make $67B merger deal as AI drives energy demand - NBC4 Washington
signals.signal_reading: Dominion-NextEra's $67B merger driven by AI energy demands positions Virginia as data center infrastructure provider rather than AI capability developer, signaling shallow platform dependency across the energy-AI stack.
